review.gallery: Nine project-specific renders from Ellington’s branded brochure. The full waterfront view leads the gallery and card. The brochure markets both phases together. Interior images are examples from that publication.
review.location: The Sands II developer brief visually marks the waterfront. GI Properties supplies an approximate Phase II point. JRE’s former Cove listing has a nearby point, which is not treated as the current entrance. Six estimates differ between the microsite and Sands II brief (page 14) and are shown as ranges. Nakheel’s Dubai Islands masterplan describes planned golf and marina infrastructure.
review.floorPlans: Both 20-page developer booklets and the two branded amenity sheets were reviewed from the broker mirror. Thirty-eight complete selectable drawings, 19 per phase. The Phase I and II example home areas match while their floor keys and retail totals differ. A Phase I legend includes studios, but both Type B layouts are titled one-bedroom and show a separate bedroom. Several printed component sums differ from totals by 0.01 sq ft. The developer-linked ZIPs returned 404.

unavailable: Surveyed visitor entrances for both phases, current public access at the named marina, a separately labelled studio unit drawing and contracted areas.
